simple.meaning: יָפוֹ (Yâphôw) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Joshua, 2 Chronicles, Ezra, Jonah, beginning at Joshua 19:46. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָפוֹ (H3305) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows יָפוֹ through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

timeline.evidenceText: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.
“Now therefore the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;

They also gave money to the masons, and to the carpenters. They also gave food, drink, and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia.

But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh.
